d.ko: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!
d.en: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!
d.zh: 杀戮。掠夺。售卖。生存！沉浸在这款融合了第一人称砍杀肉鸽与店铺经营的游戏中。在致命的地下城中搜刮战利品，全身而退，打造物品并填满你的货架。然后为了丰厚的利润，再次赌上一切！
